question: For each subnet name and its gateway IP, show the subnet name, gateway IP, and the maximum IP version among subnets whose network has a RBAC action of 'access_as_shared'. Include subtotals per subnet name and a grand total, and only keep rows where the maximum IP version is greater than 3. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(s.name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE s.name END AS subnet_name,
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(s.gateway_ip) = 1 AND GROUPING(s.name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE s.gateway_ip END AS gateway_ip,
    MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version
FROM subnets s
JOIN networks n ON s.network_id = n.id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM networkrbacs nr 
    WHERE nr.object_id = n.id 
    AND nr.action = 'access_as_shared'
)
GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip
WITH ROLLUP
HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3 OR GROUPING(s.name) = 1
